Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

We acknowledge your offer without a price adjustment clause and the index movements cited. Please provide your cost breakdown in XLSX format and revise the base price downward based on the underlying cost elements; index movements alone do not demonstrate corresponding increases in your actual costs.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94800 units per year for 24 months, 189600 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 4.79 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 90 days net, 24-month contract; option B: EUR 4.73 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 45 days net, 24-month contract; option C: EUR 4.70 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 14 days net, 24-month contract. Option A amounts to about EUR 908184 over the term.
3. Basis: On 2026-09-10 you quoted us EUR 5.45 per unit for this part; your new quote is 11.0% above it. Beyond this part, we buy Sheet 1.4301 2 mm, 2B, cut to size from another supplier today, in a volume close to this bar's, and you have quoted it for us before. Once this agreement is signed, we will invite you to quote for it. Our demand forecast for this part is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Our offer is a price of €5.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Building on your proposed 14-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.45 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.45 per unit.

This offer stays valid for 30 days. We look forward to remaining your reliable partner!

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

We note your revised offer and your confirmation that the index and volume data have been taken into account. We reject a price increase for shorter payment terms and require a lower base price in return for accepting an index-linked adjustment clause, with a defined band within which no adjustment applies.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94800 units per year for 24 months, 189600 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 4.89 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 14 days net, 24-month contract. This amounts to about EUR 927144 over the term.
3. Basis: Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account, and we have verified the LCI-C data you provided and factored it into our calculation. Please note that our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning decreases before then do not reduce our costs. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our offer is a price of €5.22 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.34 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

We note your revised offer and your confirmation that the alloy surcharge is covered at fixed prices. We require pricing no higher than the current level until that coverage expires; any adjustment clause must take effect only thereafter and be accompanied by a lower base price and a deadband.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94800 units per year for 24 months, 189600 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 4.91 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 14 days net, 24-month contract. This amounts to about EUR 930936 over the term.
3. Basis: Our invitation to quote for the other part stands once this agreement is signed. We raised quality notifications on this part over the past year (qn:20004725, qn:20004878, qn:20004895, qn:20004922, qn:20004940, qn:20004951, qn:20005016).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We always love working with you and supporting your range, so we took a very close look at your feedback. We have reviewed the quality notifications you cited; however, our evaluation shows they do not warrant a price reduction. In fact, our current defect rate for you is about 50 ppm. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. As we cannot offer a fixed price for the entire term, we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause.

Our offer is a price of €5.17 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.29 per unit.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
